relationships.name: order_customer
relationships.description: Each order belongs to one customer.

relationships.name: order_line_order
relationships.description: Each order line belongs to one order; an order can have many order lines.

relationships.name: order_line_item

relationships.name: order_sales_rep

relationships.name: customer_sales_rep
